design.authorityIsolation: effectiveReviewProjection in subjectRegistry/reviewAttestation.ts: the one boundary; a review chain is admitted whole only if every row is currently authoritative, else withheld (AUTHORITY_WITHHELD); every fact is derived from the admitted reviews only

design.protection: the union of restrictions across the three readings, plus REQUIRES_PROTECTION_REEVALUATION on STRUCTURAL_CLAIM_REVIEWED, REVIEW_CHANGES_STRUCTURAL_READING or PROTECTION_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE_AFTER_REVIEW
